699a80908991ef784965077b description:
You’ve been operating quietly. No noise, no unnecessary bodies, no attention. That doesn’t go unnoticed — not by the right people.

There’s a man tracking supply movement across Tarkov. Not a trader. Not exactly. He funds operations that stay invisible and rewards those who understand discretion. Lately, he’s been watching the same routes you’ve been moving through. That means you’ve stepped into something structured.

He wants proof you can move valuable equipment without disturbing the system behind it. Deliver the electronics to the old bunker on Woods. No fighting. No chaos. Just clean work. If he’s satisfied, I’ll make the introduction.
699a80908991ef784965077b successMessageT: Efficient. Clean. That’s what he was looking for. I passed your name along. Don’t make me regret it.
699a80908991ef784965077b startedMessageT: The bunker is isolated. Perfect for quiet work. Leave the equipment intact and unseen.

69d8db4a3b45af4d32ab83fa description:
That investor you impressed? He’s not the only one paying attention.

I’ve been seeing fragments — signals, records, movement logs. Pieces of something organized. Clean enough that it shouldn’t exist here. That kind of structure means someone built it… and someone is still maintaining it.

You’ve already been moving through parts of it. Quietly. That’s useful.

I don’t need the whole system. Just something readable. Something I can trace… and use. You bring me a clean extract from those records, and we’re not dealing in scraps anymore — we’re dealing in leverage.
69d8db4a3b45af4d32ab83fa startedMessageT: I want it clean, readable, and worth my time.
69d8db4a3b45af4d32ab83fa successMessageT: Good… this is real structure. Enough to make the right people nervous.
